# RoyalAlert - Complete API Context

RoyalAlert is a lightweight, dependency-free JavaScript alert, dialog, and toast notification library by Royal Technologies.

## Installation

**CDN:**
```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/royal-alert/dist/royal-alert.css">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/royal-alert/dist/royal-alert.min.js"></script>
```

**npm:**
```bash
npm install royal-alert
```

## API Reference

### 1. Basic Alert (`RoyalAlert.fire`)
```javascript
RoyalAlert.fire({
  title: 'Success!',
  text: 'Operation completed.',
  icon: 'success', // success, error, warning, info, question
  theme: 'auto', // light, dark, auto
  animation: 'scale' // scale, fade, slide, flip
});
```

### 2. Toast Notification (`RoyalAlert.toast`)
```javascript
RoyalAlert.toast({
  title: 'Signed in successfully',
  icon: 'success',
  position: 'bottom-left' // top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right, etc.
});
```

### 3. Confirmation Dialog (`RoyalAlert.confirm`)
```javascript
const result = await RoyalAlert.confirm({
  title: 'Are you sure?',
  text: 'You won\'t be able to revert this!',
  icon: 'warning',
  confirmButtonText: 'Yes, delete it',
  cancelButtonText: 'Cancel'
});

if (result.confirmed) {
  // Action confirmed
}
```

### 4. Input Prompt (`RoyalAlert.prompt`)
```javascript
const result = await RoyalAlert.prompt({
  title: 'Enter your name',
  inputPlaceholder: 'John Doe'
});

if (result.confirmed) {
  console.log('User entered:', result.value);
}
```

### 5. Async Operations (`RoyalAlert.async`)
```javascript
RoyalAlert.async({
  title: 'Processing...',
  text: 'Please wait while we process your request.',
  promise: fetch('/api/data'), // Any Promise
  successMessage: 'Data loaded successfully!',
  errorMessage: 'Failed to load data.'
});
```

### 6. Close Modal (`RoyalAlert.close`)
```javascript
RoyalAlert.close();
```
